ns2:section.sectionText: Course will consist of weekly readings and assignments online. Two exams can be taken on campus or off campus with a proctor. Assignments will have specific due dates throughout the semester (not self-paced). An orientation session will be held on Wednesday, June 12 from 6-7pm in 103 Mumford Hall for students who are on campus. Complete information will be sent via email on the first day of class to those registered.
